name: MTAC 264 133 (MTAC, 133 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".530". No method mark: method not stated. Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 3, MTAC - Match, Tactical: Caliber .264 (6.5mm), Grains 133, Minimum Required Twist *1-7", Part Number MTAC 264 133, G1 BC .530, OAL 1.405", Bullet Projection .720"

note: The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1 inch is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: .720".
